harvest_plan: Seed discovery from official APIs and maintained project registries.
Normalize URLs, source IDs, language tags, package coordinates, model/dataset IDs and versions.
Deduplicate by canonical ID first, then normalized URL and content checksum where applicable.
Record retrieved_at_utc, source_revision, access_method, license_url, license_expression, attribution, gated_status and checksum.
Keep discovery separate from import, validation, redistribution and model-training approval.
Use bounded pagination, conditional requests, backoff and per-host rate limits.
Never treat HTTP 200, a README badge, or a repository topic as proof of quality, completeness, safety or license compatibility.
Generate deterministic JSON/CSV reports and retain CI logs as artifacts.
notes: This is a researched seed map, not a complete census of the web.
The resources have not all been fetched, imported, checked for availability, or license-reviewed in this commit.
Bulk discovery should be incremental and respect API terms, rate limits, robots policies where applicable, and privacy law.
